sql: with a as ( select pt.market_ticker tk, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) contest, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',3) rung, pt.strategy bk, case when pt.side='no' then 100-pt.assumed_price else pt.assumed_price end ypx, pt.pnl::float pnl from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and not coalesce(pt.legacy,false) and pt.pnl is not null and pt.strategy not in (select twin_tag from live_paper_twins) and pt.market_ticker like 'KXALBUMEQUIV-%' ), lf as (select f.market_ticker tk, f.quantity q, f.price p, f.filled_at from fills f where f.market_ticker like 'KXALBUMEQUIV-%'), lost as (select tk, bool_or(pnl<0) l from a group by 1) select 'G_rung'::text sec, contest||'/'||rung k, count(*)::text n, round(avg(ypx)::numeric,1)::text entry, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text pnl, (case when bool_or(pnl<0) then 'LOST' else 'won' end) outcome, count(distinct bk)::text books, ''::text x from a where contest in ('THI26AUG13','LOS26AUG20','NOM26AUG13') group by 2,contest,rung union all select 'H_livefills', coalesce(to_char(min(filled_at),'MM-DD'),'-'), count(*)::text, sum(q)::text, round(avg(p)::numeric,1)::text, round((sum(case when lost.l then -lf.p*lf.q else (100-lf.p)*lf.q end)/100.0)::numeric,2)::text, count(distinct lf.tk)::text, sum(case when lost.l then lf.q else 0 end)::text from lf left join lost on lost.tk=lf.tk union all select 'I_strikes', coalesce(t.strike_type,'-')||'/'||coalesce(t.yes_sub_title,'-'), count(*)::text, count(distinct t.market_ticker)::text, round(avg(t.floor_strike)::numeric,0)::text, '', '', '' from mmsell_candidate_ticks t where t.market_ticker like 'KXALBUMEQUIV-%' group by 2 order by 1,2
purpose: KXALBUMEQUIV: ladder structure on the 3 losing contests, live fills, captured strikes
